messages:
Maya (Sales): Customer POC getting 403 on embeddings -> "project not bound to key". Demo Friday. Need a fast unblock.
Arjun (SE): Ask for the exact curl + key id. sa_ or sk_?
Maya (Sales): They sent: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sa-demo-55' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-lite","input":"hello"}'
```
Arjun (SE): Likely causes: 1) SA key has no project binding; 2) missing routing header for cross-tenant requests. Ask them to retry with `-H 'x-redwood-org: org_demo' -H 'x-redwood-project: prj_demo'`.
Felix (Infra): infra-log: req=qx3f status=403 code=project_binding_missing key=sa-demo-55 region=eu-west-1
Felix (Infra): We can repro. Quick remedies: reprovision SA key bound to prj_demo with scope `embeddings.generate`, short ttl; or have them use a short-lived sk_ token from portal (inherits tenant). For demo, bound SA is fastest.
Ivy (Security): For questionnaire: we store key creation/bind/rotate events, support KMS wrapping in Private, and recommend short-lived keys for POCs. I can draft a one-paragraph blurb.
Arjun (SE): I'll create a 7-day bound SA key, post id only, secret to 1Password. Also provide the curl sample they should run after we issue the secret.
Maya (Sales): Please proceed and DM the secret link to the customer contact. I'll tell them to run the retry and paste response headers if they still see 403.
Felix (Infra): If they hit 429 after this change, have them capture `edge-req-id` from response headers and timestamps; we'll correlate to rate-limiter shards.
Arjun (SE): Done - creating key now, will update ticket with key id.
KeyAuditBot: event: key_provisioned id=sa-demo-bound-7d tenant=prj_demo scopes=[embeddings.generate] created_by=arjun.se expiry=2026-07-10T12:00:00Z
Maya (Sales): Thanks team, I'll loop the customer back in and confirm.
